text: Visitors have noted issues with the timed entry system, finding the check-in process cumbersome and the timing confusing, especially for those planning shorter visits. Crowding is a common concern, particularly in the early immersive rooms, which some find too tight and uncomfortable. Several reviews criticize the use of AI in exhibits, describing it as excessive and inconsistent with the spirit of the library. Food and beverage options received negative comments regarding quality and wait times. Accessibility information and communication have also been flagged as areas needing improvement.

Several reviews mentioned confusion about the timed entry system, suggesting that guests can enter anytime after their scheduled time but only about 30 minutes before it, which affects crowding and planning. Some visitors criticized the use of AI in exhibits, feeling it was excessive and inconsistent with Theodore Roosevelt’s legacy. Positive comments focused on the interactive exhibits and the building’s architecture, but there were also remarks about crowding and the need for clearer wayfinding signage.
